SELECT eb.id, eb.institution_id, eb.institution_name, eb.business_state, eb.enterprise_nature, eb.social_credit_code, eb.registered_capital, eb.registered_currency, eb.establish_date, eb.tel, eb.email, eb.registered_address, ee.executive_name AS legal_person_name FROM `ent_basic_info` eb LEFT JOIN ( SELECT institution_id, executive_name FROM ent_executive WHERE position LIKE '%法人%' ) ee ON eb.institution_id = ee.institution_id
AND ( eb.institution_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{kw}, '%') OR ee.executive_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{kw}, '%') OR eb.social_credit_code = #{kw} )
ORDER BY eb.update_time DESC

SELECT eb.id, eb.institution_name, eb.institution_id, eb.business_state, eb.enterprise_nature, eb.social_credit_code, eb.registered_capital, eb.registered_currency, eb.establish_date, eb.tel, eb.email, eb.registered_address, ee.executive_name AS legal_person_name FROM `ent_basic_info` eb LEFT JOIN ( SELECT institution_id, executive_name FROM ent_executive WHERE position LIKE '%法人%' ) ee ON eb.institution_id = ee.institution_id
AND ( eb.institution_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dto.keyword}, '%') OR ee.executive_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dto.keyword}, '%') OR eb.social_credit_code = #{dto.keyword} )
AND eb.business_state IN
#{code}
AND (
(eb.registered_capital >= #{range.min} AND eb.registered_capital <= #{range.max})
)
AND (
(eb.establish_date >= #{range.min} AND eb.establish_date <= #{range.max})
(eb.establish_date <= #{range.max})
)
ORDER BY eb.establish_date DESC
